title: Payload: UTM operational intent volume v1
description: One 4D volume of an operational intent (ASTM F3548 concepts). Footprint is the envelope geometry, time span is start/end_datetime, converted height is height_range; original altitudes are kept here. State changes are utm.intent_state records; a new intent version supersedes the previous volumes (revision_of).

volume_type.description: nominal = conformance volume the aircraft must stay within; off_nominal = used when Nonconforming/Contingent

uas_serial.description: ANSI/CTA-2063-A serial; links to an operator, so redacted by policy for users without personal-information access
